summary:

Hello 
', confirming a reflected XSS vulnerability at security level low.

candidates.title: Reflected XSS in name parameter

candidates.poc_hint: Send GET request to http://127.0.0.1:8080/vulnerabilities/xss_r/?name=<script>alert(1)</script>. The injected script appears verbatim inside the <pre> element in the response body, confirming no sanitization. This can be used to execute arbitrary JavaScript.
